sql: DO $$ DECLARE i integer := 0; BEGIN BEGIN WHILE i < 3 LOOP i := i + 1; END LOOP; PERFORM 1/0; EXCEPTION WHEN division_by_zero THEN RAISE NOTICE 'i=%', i; END; END $$;
note: exception in loop's outer block, variable value preserved

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v text; BEGIN BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'test' USING ERRCODE='23505', COLUMN='my_col'; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v = COLUMN_NAME; RAISE NOTICE 'col=%', v; END; END $$;
